# `morphir metadata validate-trusted`

- **Usage:** `morphir metadata validate-trusted <FLAGS>`

Validate with declarations from a freshly authenticated Library restore

## Flags
- **`--ir <IR>`** — Consumer V4.1 single-file IR to validate
- **`--provider-release <PACKAGE@VERSION>`** — Exact provider Library release in the full lock
- **`--policy <POLICY>`** — Explicit trusted-host policy file
- **`--lock <LOCK>`** — Full package lock; replay never rewrites it
- **`--registry <REGISTRY>`** — Caller-controlled local registry
- **`--state <STATE>`** — Existing initialized trust-state directory
- **`--assurance <ASSURANCE>`** — Accept the local MVP's caller-controlled filesystem roots

  **Choices:** `portable`
